author: EmuCore - Hub
title: How To Automatically Backup PCSX2 Memory Cards
summary: dotcom builds an automatic PCSX2 memory-card backup routine with Windows batch files and Task Scheduler, turning save protection into a repeatable workflow while exposing the paths and scheduled execution that must be customized safely.

blocks.text: The eleven-minute tutorial treats a virtual memory card as user data that deserves independent copies, not as an invisible emulator detail. Its chapters first examine two batch files, then configure Windows Task Scheduler and finally demonstrate the job running. The useful design is the separation between a source card directory and a destination chosen by the player. Once those paths are explicit, a scheduled task can create protection without relying on someone remembering to copy files after every long session.

The downloadable scripts are hosted on a third-party Drive link and should never be executed unseen. Open them in a text editor, verify every command and replace both paths with exact local folders before scheduling anything. The description does not document retention, collision handling, cloud synchronization or a tested restore procedure; repeatedly copying one damaged card can also overwrite a good backup. Add dated versions, keep another device or service as a second destination, and prove restoration with a disposable card copy.
